menu.title: MENU
keyword.DEVOUR:
DEVOUR: remove a card from the game.
It goes to the devoured pile.
keyword.SUPPLANT:
SUPPLANT: assassinate a troop where you have presence,
then deploy your own troop in its place.
keyword.DEPLOY:
DEPLOY: put a troop from your barracks on a free space
where you have presence.
keyword.ASSASSINATE:
ASSASSINATE: remove a troop where you have presence.
It goes to your trophy hall (1 VP each).
keyword.PLACE:
PLACE A SPY: put a spy on a site.
It gives you presence there and counts for control.
keyword.RETURN:
RETURN: send a troop or spy where you have presence
back to its owner.
keyword.PROMOTE:
PROMOTE: move a card into your Inner Circle.
It leaves your deck and scores its Inner Circle VP.
keyword.RECRUIT: RECRUIT: take a card into your discard pile.
keyword.FOCUS:
FOCUS: works if you played another card of this aspect
this turn or reveal one from your hand.
keyword.DEVOTION: DEVOTION: works when you recruit or promote this card.
keyword.GLAMOUR:
GLAMOUR: spend 1 VP token (back to the supply) to switch this ability on.
Only one Glamour per card.
keyword.TRANSFORM: TRANSFORM: this card turns into the stronger card it names.
